sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners,
learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the Informant.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.1859 of 2024 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C. Chandikhole arising out of Byree P.S. Case No.179 of 2024 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 294/ 420/ 323/ 506/ 34 of IPC.
3.
The memo filed by the Petitioners indicating that there are cases against the Informant under Section 138 of NI Act is taken on record.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioners that it's a commercial transaction relating to non-supply of garlic and is an offshoot of a complaint case and as such the import of the allegations being in the realm of the contract the Petitioner ought not to be subjected to custodial interrogation.
5. It is also stated with vehemence that the Petitioners do not have any criminal proclivity.

6. Learned counsel for the State as well as informant oppose the prayer.

7. It is the submission of the learned counsel for the Informant that after getting delivery of the garlic in question, the Petitioners repeatedly assured for payment and later on did not honor his commitment and when he was asked for the payment he threaten the informant.
Hence no leniency ought to be shown since mens rea is tell-tale from the inception.

8. On considering the rival submission and taking into account the punishment prescribed and the genesis of the allegation, this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioners shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper subject to verification of criminal antecedent of similar nature.
9. If it comes to the fore that the Petitioners have any such criminal antecedent, this order shall not be given effect to.
10. It is needless to state that the Petitioners shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.
11. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
12. U.C.C. as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Santoshi Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Manas Kumar vs State Of Odisha ....
